chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amer narrated to us from his uncle Abdullah ibn 'Amer from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr from Aban ibn 'Uthman from Aban ibn Taghlub from 'Ikrama from Ibn 'Abbas. He said:

When the first silver coin and gold coin hit the ground, Iblis looked to them. When he observed them, he took them and placed them on his eyes. Then, he embraced them to his chest. Then, he screamed. Then, he embraced them to his chest. Then, he said: You two are the joy of my eye and the fruit of my heart. I would not mind if the Children of Adam loved you instead of worshiping idols. For me, it is sufficient for the Children of Adam to love you.
ai.seo_question: What did Iblis (Satan) say when the first coins were minted?
ai.summary: Ibn 'Abbas narrates a vivid account of how Iblis (Satan) reacted when the first silver and gold coins were minted on earth. Iblis placed them on his eyes, embraced them to his chest, screamed in delight, and declared that the love of money among humankind would be sufficient to replace idol worship. This hadith warns about the spiritual danger of attachment to wealth.
word_analysis: and it is sufficient for me

When the first silver coin and gold coin hit the ground, Iblis looked to them. When he observed them, he took them and placed them on his eyes. Then, he embraced them to his chest. Then, he screamed. Then, he embraced them to his chest. Then, he said: You two are the joy of my eye and the fruit of my heart. I would not mind if the Children of Adam loved you instead of worshiping idols. For me, it is sufficient for the Children of Adam to love you.
